name: Kagekari
storyline: Bound to a secluded dojo by a forbidden art, a lone shinobi stands as the last barrier against an encroaching tide of darkness in legendary Japan. As ancient yōkai emerge from the shadows—culminating in the dreaded Hyakki Yagyō, the Night Parade of One Hundred Demons—the warrior must master and fuse elemental jutsu to survive. Harvest the souls of fallen spirits to unlock ancient powers, uncover hidden threats, and confront the legendary overlords of folklore before the realm is consumed.
summary: Kagekari is a top-down action roguelite inspired by Japanese folklore. A young shinobi hunts yōkai wave after wave, builds a run with jutsu techniques and shop items, and combines elements: water and lightning stun, fire burns. Free demo playable in the browser and on Windows, with Japanese voice acting and subtitles.
